input.problem_statement: Order exceptions wait in a shared queue and commercial teams spend too much time collecting context before deciding what to do.
input.desired_outcome: Resolve common exceptions earlier without giving an AI system broad permission to change commercial data.

expected.ideal_result: A valid exception is recognized and prepared for resolution before delivery risk appears, with minimal new queueing and no broad autonomous write access.

experiment.change: Run an AI assistant in read-first mode and let it prepare bounded change proposals for selected exception classes.
experiment.failure_condition: Control failures or correction cost increase beyond the agreed threshold.

input.problem_statement: Several consumers repeatedly poll a transactional system for status changes.
input.desired_outcome: Keep consumers reasonably current while reducing source-system load and availability coupling.

expected.ideal_result: Consumers react to relevant state changes without blocking the source transaction or continuously polling the source.

experiment.change: Publish one stable business event for selected state transitions and migrate one consumer from polling.
experiment.failure_condition: Freshness or delivery reliability becomes worse than the polling baseline.

input.problem_statement: Every master-data request follows the same review chain although many requests fail only predictable completeness or duplicate checks.
input.desired_outcome: Shorten request lead time without reducing master-data quality.

expected.ideal_result: Exact quality checks happen before human review; people spend time only on ambiguous or policy-sensitive cases.

experiment.change: Pre-validate exact rules and surface ranked duplicate evidence before the approval step.
experiment.failure_condition: Quality defects increase despite lower lead time.

input.problem_statement: A global process template keeps growing country and business-unit branches until the common process becomes difficult to understand and change.
input.desired_outcome: Preserve enterprise policy while allowing valid local variation without duplicating the whole process.

expected.ideal_result: Stable global states and policy remain common while contextual local decisions are isolated behind explicit rule boundaries.

experiment.change: Extract one high-variation branch into a governed local decision layer while keeping the common process states unchanged.
experiment.failure_condition: Local divergence creates new enterprise control gaps.

input.problem_statement: An operations assistant can investigate incidents across several systems, but direct remediation tools would create a large blast radius.
input.desired_outcome: Use agentic investigation to reduce diagnosis time without turning model reasoning into production authorization.

expected.ideal_result: The agent investigates adaptively with read tools, stops on insufficient evidence, and can prepare but not authorize high-impact remediation.

experiment.change: Run the agent in shadow mode on historical and selected live incidents with read-only tools.
experiment.failure_condition: The agent cannot reliably stop, explain evidence, or avoid unsafe proposals.
